steps: Make the dressing: in a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, garlic, oregano, Dijon mustard, salt, and several grinds of black pepper.
On a large platter, arrange cucumber, green bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, feta, red onion, and olives.
Drizzle with the dressing and very gently toss.
Sprinkle with a few generous pinches of oregano and top with mint leaves. Season to taste and serve.
notes: Feta in brine is best for this recipe. Good make-ahead salad; add mint leaves right before serving.
